title: Sydney Marathon 2026 – transportnsw.info event page（2026-11-07 复核：原页已下线，仅保留查阅记录）
claims: The event page states that 40,000 participants will take part in the 42 km Sydney Marathon on Sunday 30 August 2026.
The event page lists the marathon start at 06:15, the finish at 15:40 and the Recovery Village closing at 16:00.
Travel on public transport is included in the Sydney Marathon event registration when a race bib is shown to transport staff.
An additional station access fee applies to travel to and from Sydney International and Domestic Airport train stations and is not covered by the marathon entry or the event travel entitlement.

Participants in start groups Purple and Orange should arrive via Victoria Cross Metro Station or North Sydney Train Station, and participants in start group Green should arrive via Crows Nest Metro Station.

The M1 metro line runs between Tallawong, Chatswood and Sydenham; early services start around 3.30am from Tallawong and 4am from Sydenham, with trains every four minutes until 8am and every five minutes until 3pm.

Arrivals before 6am at North Sydney station exit via Blue St, turn right and cross Pacific Hwy to Walker St; after 6am they use the Greenwood Plaza Pacific Hwy pedestrian bridge to Denison St, then Berry St and Walker St.

From Victoria Cross metro, exit at Denison St, turn right onto Berry St and left onto Walker St; from Crows Nest metro, exit at Clarke St and continue via Willoughby Rd, Burlington St, West St and Falcon St.
A dedicated drop-off is available at ANZAC Public School on Anzac Ave off Ernest St, with accessible drop-off in the North Sydney Boys High School car park on Falcon St.

Significant city-wide road closures will be in place between 2am and 4.30pm from North Sydney, the Sydney CBD, Pyrmont, Darlinghurst, Moore Park to Kingsford, with special event clearway parking restrictions from 12.01am Sunday.

Key closures include the Sydney Harbour Bridge, Cahill Expressway and Western Distributor from 3am to 11am, Macquarie Street and Oxford Street from 4am to 4pm or 4.30pm, and Anzac Parade from 5am to 2pm.
The Cross City Tunnel will be toll-free from 5am to 4.30pm for motorists crossing the course east-west.

Additional early trains will run to arrive at North Sydney from 4am; specific extra services include T1 North Shore trains leaving Berowra at 2.59am and 3.30am, a T1 Western train leaving Penrith at 3.30am, T9 Northern trains leaving Hornsby at 3.10am and 3.40am, a T2 Inner West train leaving Ashfield at 3.58am, a T2 train leaving Liverpool at 3.45am, T6 Bankstown trains at 3.25am and 3.50am, T4 Cronulla trains at 2.47am and 3.17am, and a T8 Airport & South train leaving Revesby at 3.10am.
The closest train station to the start area for the marathon is North Sydney on the T1 North Shore Line and T9 Northern Line.
From the finish line at the Opera House, the closest station is Circular Quay, with Wynyard and Martin Place within short walking distance.

Sydney Marathon participants and volunteers can travel on Sydney Trains, NSW TrainLink Intercity services, Sydney Metro, metropolitan and outer metropolitan buses, light rail and ferries on Saturday 29 and Sunday 30 August 2026 by showing a race bib, finishers medal or volunteer t-shirt, with the entitlement valid until 4am the next day.
The Sydney Marathon Running Expo runs from Thursday 27 to Saturday 29 August 2026 at Sydney Olympic Park, and volunteers are entitled to travel to and from the Expo on those services.

Spectators can reach the start line by metro to Victoria Cross, the spectator site at Barangaroo, the Customs House festival and Opera House finish by train to Circular Quay, and the Moore Park spectator hub by light rail from Town Hall.

The page lists bus changes including buses across the Harbour Bridge ending at Crows Nest, St Leonards or Macquarie Park, and city-east buses starting and ending at Kings Cross or Woolloomooloo until mid-afternoon.
